citations.passage: Assumption on record: throughput scales linearly with scan volume.

Silas benchmarked the OCR pipeline against the ocr-comparison assumption: on
real archival page scans — foxed paper, old typefaces — throughput ran at
roughly forty percent of the assumed rate once image preprocessing landed.

archival scans run at roughly forty percent of
the assumed rate, so the digitization schedule stretches

judge.rationale: The agent correctly identifies d-004’s remote-API assumption, s-006 as the contradicting benchmark, and m-007 as the Bellweather review, but it omits the benchmark’s quantitative findings (fourfold throughput, linear-scaling assumption, and archival scans at roughly 40% of the assumed rate) and incorrectly substitutes an invented IIIF-viewer scope reduction for the reference’s stretched digitization schedule.
